verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs claim drill-down in its Excel/Sheets workflows, automated financial reporting, and answers traceable to clickable source citations, which covers the drill-to-source half of the story. Nothing names P&L, balance sheet, or cash flow statement views specifically, and all evidence is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: explicit P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement views; documentation that drill-down reaches transaction-level source records from any figure; independent or hands-on corroboration.
